question: Choose the antonym of ‘prudent’:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Thoughtless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"prudent"** means acting with or showing care and thought for the future. (सावधान, विवेकपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** It is prudent to save money for emergencies rather than spending it all at once.
 
 
 
• The word **"Thoughtless"** refers to someone who does not show consideration or care for others or does things without thinking carefully. (बेबाक, लापरवाह)
 
 
• **Example:** His thoughtless remarks hurt her feelings deeply.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"prudent"** is **"thoughtless"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Thoughtless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Undicious** (अविवेकपूर्ण): This is not a valid English word. It might be a typographical error for "Injudicious," which means showing poor judgment.

 
 
• **Example:** His injudicious decision to spend all the money on luxuries led to financial trouble.
 
 
 
• **Cautious** (सावधान): Being careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
 
 
• **Example:** The mountaineer was cautious while climbing the steep cliff.
 
 
 
• **Sensible** (समझदार): Having or showing good sense or judgment.
 
 
• **Example:** It was sensible of her to carry an umbrella during the rainy season.
 
 

156:Tbe7,
The correct answer is Option 1<
